title: A.I., Mars and Immortality: Are We Dreaming Big Enough? | Interesting Times with Ross Douthat
summary: Ross Douthat interviews Peter Thiel about technological stagnation, AI, longevity, space travel and politics. Thiel also lays out his framing of the Antichrist as a risk of civilizational stagnation.
why: Commenters cite it as the primary source for Thiel's Antichrist argument whenever his views come up.

quote.text: worth watching the interview with the NYT's Ross Douthat
